ModMetaData.name: Background Planning for Colony Manager Redux
ModMetaData.author: archdukejim
ModMetaData.description: Turns colony management into paperwork. Instead of a colonist standing at the desk while the manager works out what to do, the thinking happens on its own schedule -- anchored to a set hour of the day, so a job that runs every four hours runs at 4am, 8am, noon and so on rather than four hours after whenever it last happened to run. The result is posted to the manager desk as a bill, exactly like a production order, and sits there as an unfinished plan: a book on the desk that can't be hauled away, costs no materials, can be cancelled, and vanishes when it's done. A manager works through it at a speed set by their Intellectual and Social skills, gaining both, and can be interrupted and come back to it. The moment the plan is signed off, every designation it decided on lands on the map at once. An unclaimed plan expires when the next one is drawn up.
